seoDescription: P-CCS students start August 31, 2026, and finish June 9, 2027. See half days, school breaks, K–5 conferences, P-CEP finals and testing dates, and the official district calendar.
heroSummary: P-CCS students start Monday, August 31, 2026, with a half day for all K–12 students. Kindergarten remains on half days September 1–2, while grades 1–12 attend full days. The last day is Wednesday, June 9, 2027, and both June 8 and June 9 are half days for all K–12 students.
calendarNotes: All K–12 students begin August 31 on a half day, and kindergarten alone continues with half days September 1–2. October 30 is an all-student K–12 half day, while November 11–12, December 9, and March 12 shorten only the K–5 schedule. January finals are marked as half days; the April state-testing dates are not. June 7 is a grades 9–12 finals half day before all K–12 students move to half days June 8–9.
heroFactChips: Last day June 9 is a half day

customSections.label: Kindergarten Starts With Three Half Days
customSections.content: The first half day includes all K–12 students. Kindergarten stays on half days for two more dates while grades 1–12 begin full-day attendance.

customSections.label: What “P-CEP” Means on the Calendar
customSections.content: P-CEP refers to Canton, Plymouth, and Salem high schools, which share the Plymouth-Canton Educational Park. Students have a home high school but can take classes across the three buildings, so P-CEP testing and finals dates generally apply across the shared campus.

customSections.label: P-CCS Half-Day Dismissal Times
customSections.content: Dismissal times vary by school level. P-CEP also uses a separate exam-day dismissal time for finals.

table.footnote: Check the live district and school calendars in case P-CCS changes bell times after publication.

customSections.label: Grades 6–12 Half Days, Finals, and State Testing
customSections.content: January finals are marked as half days. The April state-testing dates are not. Testing dates differ by grade level.

customSections.label: Which P-CCS Calendar Should Families Use?
customSections.content: The one-page family calendar covers the main districtwide K–12 dates. P-CEP families should also use campus schedules for classes and activities. Starkweather students should use the academy's separate quarterly calendar for attendance dates. Wayne County's common calendar explains shared break dates but does not replace the P-CCS family calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When does P-CCS start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: All K–12 students start Monday, August 31, 2026, on a half-day schedule. Kindergarten also attends half days September 1–2 while grades 1–12 have full days.

calendarFaqs.q: When is P-CCS Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Classes resume Monday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is P-CCS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 29, through Friday, April 2, 2027. Classes resume April 5.

calendarFaqs.q: What time does a P-CCS half day end?
calendarFaqs.a: The family calendar lists 12:10 p.m. for elementary schools, 11:30 a.m. for middle schools, 10:35 a.m. for a regular P-CEP half day, 10:40 a.m. for a P-CEP exam day, and 11:25 a.m. for Starkweather Academy.

calendarFaqs.q: Which P-CCS dates are K–5-only half days in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: K–5 students have half days November 11–12 for afternoon conferences, December 9, and March 12. October 30 and June 8–9 are half days for all K–12 students.

calendarFaqs.q: Are the April P-CCS state-testing dates half days?
calendarFaqs.a: The family calendar lists grades 6–8 state testing April 13 and grades 9–12 testing April 14–15, but it does not label those dates as half days or no-school days.

calendarFaqs.q: When are P-CEP finals half days in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 9–12 have finals half days January 13 and June 7. Grades 6–12 are also on half-day schedules January 14–15.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Starkweather follow the district family calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Not for every attendance date. The district family PDF lists Starkweather bell times, but Starkweather publishes a separate quarterly calendar with its own registration, records, conference, incentive, and graduation dates.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of P-CCS in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Wednesday, June 9, 2027, is the last day and a half day for all K–12 students. June 8 is also an all-student half day.
